description: Land Acquisition - Punchilewakandawatta, Yatawatta D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes the specific land parcel being acquired (Lewakandawaththa, 0.1012 Hectare), its location, purpose (construction of Mahalewakanda water tank), and provides details about the acquisition process including claimant information and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
